entries.notes: Complete A-Omega DjVu OCR. Greek is mostly recognised, but expect occasional Greek->Latin misreads (e.g. 'Bopav' for Βορᾶν), papyrus sigla noise, page headers, and two-column interleaving. Headwords usually stand alone on a line ending with '.' or ','. Entry segmentation must be heuristic.

Places searched: eBible.org translations.csv (only spaRV1909, sparvg, spav1602p); GitHub repository search (no results); es.wikisource.org (Biblia del oso is a 474-byte scan-link page, no text); archive.org full-text OCR (la-biblia-del-oso, labibliaqveeslos00rein, LaSantaBibliaversinDeCasiodoroDeReinaAAo1.569BibliaDelOso: facsimile OCR with long-s misreads, two columns and no verse numbers in the 1569 print, so it cannot be segmented reliably; BibliaElOso: a modernized later revision, not the 1569 text); bibliavida.com and devocionalescristianos.org (web/PDF reading only, no downloadable text). Not vendored: a false text would be worse than none.
